title: Loan Seasoning and the Interest Rounded in an Auto Loan Settlement
content:
How the interest in the settlement of a loan of the Auto Loans line is rounded follows how long the loan has been on the books, counted in whole months from the date it funded to the day of the settlement.

1. Where the loan was funded at least 36 whole months before the settlement, the interest is rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. Where the loan was funded at least 24 but less than 36 whole months before the settlement, the interest is rounded half-up to the whole dollar.
3. Where the loan was funded less than 24 whole months before the settlement, the interest is rounded half-up to the cent.

## The same interest under each convention

Take interest of 132.92 before rounding. On a loan funded 48 whole months before the settlement it becomes 132.00. On a loan funded 30 whole months before it becomes 133.00. On a loan funded 15 whole months before it stands at 132.92.

Take interest of 61.35 instead. At 48 whole months it becomes 61.00; at 30 whole months it becomes 61.00, the cents being below the half; at 15 whole months it stands at 61.35.

## Where the conventions part company

A loan funded exactly 36 whole months before the settlement is rounded down to the whole dollar. A loan funded exactly 24 whole months before is rounded half-up to the whole dollar. A loan funded 23 whole months before is rounded half-up to the cent.
